entries.message: had {name} changed after it rendered its default input, which keeps the value it was made with.
entries.fix: Change the input itself (it is the source of truth once rendered), or write your own <input> inside.

entries.message: holds an input with no accessible name (no label, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title), so a screen reader announces only its type.
entries.fix: Put it in a <label>, give it a <label for>, or wrap it in <vera-field> with a <label>.

entries.message: has reveal on an input of type {type}, which shows its text already, so reveal does nothing.
has a size attribute, which <vera-input> does not read (on <input> it means a width in characters).
entries.fix: Use scale="sm|md|lg" for the size, or put size on the <input> itself.
